Norwegian Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in Norway comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Norwegian documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe Politiet1850–6300 NOK
Driving Licencethe Statens vegvesen1300–4900 NOK
ID Cardthe Skatteetaten950–3100 NOK
Green Cardthe UDI3300–10800 NOK
Visaa Norwegian embassy1550–5300 NOK
Residence Permitthe UDI3200–9200 NOK

Two checks specific to Norway

  • Check the licence for the Statens vegvesen mark and the two part category layout.
  • Confirm the passport crest and the eleven digit national identity number checksum.

Local red flag

  • A document with a national identity number that fails both checksum digits.
